name: isotox-mixed
comment: THE ISOTOXAL PALETTE AT MIXED CLOSURE (2026-08-25, AL). Same nine tiles as isotox-wide, both signs of defect admitted. ⚑ THE OBSTRUCTION IS THE CLOSURE, NOT A CIRCUMSPHERE. A vertex figure is a closed spherical polygon whose SIDES are the face angles, and each side must be under the sum of the others; the 5*12 dent is 252 degrees, so the rest of that vertex must sum PAST 252 and the total past 504 — a SADDLE vertex. positive-defect admits only convex vertices (total under 360), so it excludes every dent vertex by construction, which is why all 935 star-bearing blocks at k=2..4 returned zero dihedral solutions. That says nothing about inscribability: the whole ncx shelf is non-inscribable and still positive-defect. Mixed is the closure a concave star face needs, and it is the one the genus shelves already use.
